title: Cloud Lab 1 — Container Resources
description: Real container resources. Select services, follow a run time range, then compare consumption, ceilings and throttling. Five-second refresh; resource rates use 30-second averages.

panels.title: Collection health · cAdvisor
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health only. This does not establish application health.

panels.title: CPU usage · cores
panels.description: CPU seconds per second. 1.0 means one fully occupied CPU core, not 100% of the laptop.

targets.expr: sum by (service, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!="",cpu="total"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!=""} > time() - 15))

panels.title: Memory working set · MiB
panels.description: Container working set includes the server and its child process; it is not just the requested allocation.

targets.expr: max by (service, name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!=""} and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!=""} > time() - 15)) / 1024 / 1024

panels.title: Network receive · bytes/s
panels.description: Incoming traffic on the single bridge interface. Loopback and host aggregates are excluded.

targets.expr: sum by (service, name) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!="",interface="eth0"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!=""} > time() - 15))

panels.title: Network transmit · bytes/s
panels.description: Outgoing traffic on eth0. Downloading payloads from Flask increases this measurement.

targets.expr: sum by (service, name) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!="",interface="eth0"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!=""} > time() - 15))

panels.title: 02 / ALLOCATION & THROTTLING · separate usage from limits
CPU usage relative to quota · 30s average
panels.description: Share of this container CPU ceiling. Uses cAdvisor quota/period; absent/unlimited quotas are unavailable.

panels.title: Memory usage relative to limit
panels.description: Working set divided by container memory ceiling; includes Python and telemetry overhead.

panels.title: Scheduling periods throttled
panels.description: Fraction of scheduled periods throttled, not a CPU-utilization percentage.

panels.title: Throttled seconds per second
panels.description: Throttled duration per second. This can differ from the fraction of scheduling periods throttled.

panels.title: 03 / COMPUTE COMPARISONS · aggregate and individual instances
Aggregate Compute CPU
panels.description: Sum across active Compute instances. Replica-2 doubles allocated CPU and Compute memory.

panels.title: Recent CPU cores · last collection interval
panels.description: Last two collection samples (approximately five seconds apart). Useful when fixed work completes inside the 30-second averaging window. Short samples fluctuate; compare with the original averaged panel.

targets.expr: sum by (service, name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!="",cpu="total"}[30s]) and on (id) (container_last_seen{project="cloud-lab1",service=~"$service",name!=""} > time() - 15))
